metadata.source: EARTH LENS v0.3 authored physical geography demo
metadata.note: Representative centers and broad visual footprints only; not measured boundaries.

features.name: HIMALAYAS
features.description: A high mountain system forming a major physical barrier between South and Central Asia.

features.name: TIBETAN PLATEAU
features.description: A broad high plateau adjoining the Himalayas and shaping regional drainage and movement.

features.name: ANDES
features.description: A long mountain barrier along the western edge of South America.

features.name: ROCKY MOUNTAINS
features.description: A major north–south mountain system in western North America.

features.name: ALPS
features.description: A compact European mountain barrier crossed through a limited set of corridors and passes.

features.name: ZAGROS MOUNTAINS
features.description: A mountain belt forming a pronounced physical barrier along the western Iranian plateau.

features.name: SAHARA
features.description: A vast arid region that constrains settlement, infrastructure, and overland movement.

features.name: GOBI
features.description: A large arid region across Mongolia and northern China.

features.name: STRAIT OF MALACCA
features.description: A narrow natural maritime corridor between the Malay Peninsula and Sumatra.

features.name: STRAIT OF HORMUZ
features.description: A narrow natural outlet connecting the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman.

features.name: BOSPORUS
features.description: A narrow natural waterway between the Black Sea and the Sea of Marmara.
